requirements.title: REDUCE argument restrictions
requirements.definition: ARRAY shall be an array of any type; OPERATION shall be a pure two-argument scalar function with dummy arguments and result matching ARRAY's declared type and type parameters and with the stated nonallocatable, noncoarray, nonpointer, nonpolymorphic, nonoptional dummy-object restrictions and paired ASYNCHRONOUS, TARGET, and VALUE attributes; DIM, MASK, IDENTITY, and ORDERED shall satisfy their stated type, shape, and value restrictions.

pending.REDUCE-ARRAY-array-any-type: Positive source controls use integer rank-one and rank-two ARRAY values; source-control mutation uses a scalar actual and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.REDUCE-OPERATION-pure-two-argument-compa: Positive source control supplies a pure integer function taking two scalar integer dummy data objects and returning integer; mutations use an impure function, rank-one dummy, mismatched real dummy, and mismatched result type without claiming diagnostic facets.
pending.REDUCE-OPERATION-dummy-attribute-pairing: Positive source controls use ordinary dummies and paired VALUE dummies; mutation gives VALUE to only one dummy and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.REDUCE-DIM-integer-scalar-in-rank-range: Positive controls call REDUCE on rank-two arrays with DIM=1 and DIM=2; mutations use DIM=0, DIM=3, and rank-one DIM actuals without claiming diagnostic facets.
pending.REDUCE-MASK-logical-conformable: Positive controls use scalar-free rank-conformable logical MASK arrays with nontrivial true and false elements; mutations use integer MASK and a nonconformable logical MASK without claiming diagnostic facets.
pending.REDUCE-IDENTITY-scalar-same-type-paramet: Positive controls use scalar integer IDENTITY for integer ARRAY and scalar character IDENTITY matching character length; mutations use array IDENTITY and mismatched type parameters without claiming diagnostic facets.
pending.REDUCE-ORDERED-logical-scalar: Positive controls use ORDERED=.true. and ORDERED=.false.; mutations use integer and rank-one logical ORDERED actuals without claiming diagnostic facets.

requirements.title: REDUCE result characteristics
requirements.definition: The REDUCE result has ARRAY's declared type and type parameters, is scalar without DIM, and has rank n-1 and the shape formed by removing dimension DIM from ARRAY with DIM present.

pending.REDUCE-result-type-parameters-match-ARRA: Use integer and character ARRAY controls with character length greater than one; assert assignment to matching result variables succeeds and character LEN is preserved, then mutate ARRAY type or length in the expected declaration.
pending.REDUCE-result-scalar-without-DIM: Call REDUCE on a rank-one integer vector without DIM, initialize a scalar sentinel to -999, and assert the scalar product is stored; mutation adds DIM=1 and expects an array context.
pending.REDUCE-result-rank-and-shape-with-DIM: Call REDUCE on a rank-three array with shape [2,3,4] and DIM=2; assert RANK(result)==2 and SHAPE(result)==[2,4], with companion DIM=1 producing [3,4] to avoid a vacuous shape check.

requirements.title: REDUCE case (i) combines adjacent sequence elements
requirements.definition: For REDUCE without DIM or MASK, the initial sequence is ARRAY in array element order and iterative OPERATION calls replace adjacent pairs until one value remains; ORDERED true selects the first two sequence elements at each iteration.

pending.REDUCE-sequence-array-element-order: Use a rank-two integer ARRAY with distinctive array element order and an ORDERED=.true. operation that encodes pair order into decimal digits; assert the final encoded value and mutate the array constructor order.
pending.REDUCE-ordered-true-left-adjacent-fold: Use ORDERED=.true. with a noncommutative pure operation f(x,y)=10*x+y over [1,2,3]; assert the left-adjacent fold result differs from swapped-argument mutation.
pending.REDUCE-associative-product-result: Use pure integer multiplication over [1,2,3,4] and assert result 24 with the result scalar initialized to -777; mutation changes one array element so the product check fails.
